_how_to_add: One entry per video. n is the number said in the video and pinned comment ('Gear from this video: steelgamesapp.com/s #12'); never reuse or renumber. Give the pick either amazon (an ASIN) or brand + url. No prices for Amazon picks (Associates rules). Then run: python3 tools/videos_page.py

videos.title: Best Mouse Settings for Gaming: Turn Off Pointer Precision
videos.tip: Pointer precision speeds your cursor up when you move fast, so your aim changes with hand speed. Turn it off for consistent aim.

pick.name: Logitech G305 Lightspeed Wireless Mouse
pick.why: A light, accurate wireless mouse that won't cost much. A good first upgrade from an office mouse.

alt.name: Redragon Impact Elite M913
alt.why: Wireless with side buttons, for MMO and shooter players.

videos.title: Best Gaming Mouse Specs: Ignore DPI, Check These 3
videos.tip: Max DPI is marketing. Weight, shape and sensor quality matter more for aim.

videos.title: Best Mouse DPI and Sensitivity for Gaming (eDPI Explained)
videos.tip: eDPI = DPI x in-game sensitivity. Most pros play low, which means bigger arm movements.

pick.name: SteelSeries QcK XXL Mousepad
pick.why: Low sensitivity needs room. An XXL pad gives your whole arm space to aim.
